unit: index = realised import unit value from Russia relative to the country's own 2018-2021 average (= 1); levels in EUR/t (crude, oil products, diesel, fuel oil, coal) or EUR/MWh GCV (LNG, pipeline gas); paid / at_base_prices / windfall in EUR bn, nominal

definitions.index: Unit value (customs value / customs quantity of imports from Russia) in the year divided by the mean of the country's 2018-2021 unit values (years with purchases). Where a year has no usable customs quantity, the level is a benchmark Russian export price times the country's own customs/benchmark ratio (see basis).
definitions.fossil_all: Implied fossil price index = fossil paid / (same volumes at the country's 2018-2021 unit values); volume-weighted, so it moves with the fuel mix.
definitions.non_fuel_goods: Weighted index of non-fuel imports from Russia: weights = the country's 2018-2021 import values by product (fertilisers, iron and steel, aluminium, nickel, copper, PGMs, gold, iron ore, wheat, barley, maize, rapeseed, sunflower oil, wood, pulp, fish, uranium); product indices = customs unit values (own if large, else panel of all reporters); remaining goods follow the euro-area industrial import price index excluding energy.
definitions.paid: Value of imports from Russia covered by the windfall calculation: fuels (customs values; final-use volumes x country price for pipeline gas in transit countries; CREA volumes x price where customs are missing) plus non-fuel goods (total imports from Russia minus customs HS 27).
definitions.at_base_prices: The same volumes valued at the country's 2018-2021 average unit values (non-fuel goods: paid / non-fuel index).
definitions.windfall: paid - at_base_prices = extra revenue Russia received from this country because prices were above the pre-war level. Negative in years when prices were below the 2018-2021 average (e.g. 2020).
definitions.windfall_parts: windfall split by fuel (crude, products, coal, lng, pipeline_gas, other_fossil) and non_fuel_goods; paid = the matching paid value. Diesel and fuel oil are inside products.
definitions.certainty: Share of the country's 2022-2026 purchases of the fuel (by value) priced with its own customs unit values: A >= 90%, B >= 50% (or a gas_prices.json estimate), C < 50% (benchmark price x ratio).
definitions.ranges: low/high are meant as ~90% intervals: customs measurement (+/-3% Comext, +/-4% Comtrade, more for small quantities or when Comext and Comtrade disagree), benchmark disagreement and the spread of buyer-specific price shifts for filled years; index ranges combine year and base error; windfall ranges combine volume, year-price and base-price errors.
